Save final PNGs beneath output_root; record generated source, actual saved path, PNG dimensions, SHA-256 and visual validation per completed asset.

For a FRONT view the attached picture is this SAME character's approved look: keep the face, skin tone, eyes, hair, body shape and proportions exactly the same, with a friendly happy expression - change ONLY the clothes and accessories as described. For a BACK view the attached picture is the new outfit from the front: show the same character from directly behind, same pose, every color the same as the front. Clean, simple 3D cartoon toy style exactly like the attached picture: every area one smooth, flat, solid color, with no texture at all - no fabric grain, no knit, no fluffy fur strands, no stitching, no sparkles or glitter, no folds or wrinkles painted on, no shading or shadows painted on, nothing see-through and nothing glowing (lights are solid bright colors). Small details as simple solid shapes, close to the body - nothing thin or long sticking out (no strings, no straps hanging loose, no scarf ends flying). No logos, brand marks, emblems, swooshes, stripes on shoes, printed words, letters, numbers or graphics. Not like any famous character from a film, cartoon, ballet production or game. Full body standing in an A-pose: arms straight and angled clearly down and away from the body with a clear gap between each arm and the body all the way down, hands open, legs slightly apart, feet flat. Centered and filling the whole height, nothing cropped. Plain flat light-gray background, even soft light, no floor shadow. One character only, no text.

BACK view of Jingle Bell Echo, matching the reference exactly: the back of her curly brown hair with the red goggles and the two gold bells at the sides, the back of the red jacket with its white collar, the green hood lying flat, green joggers, white sneakers with red soles

assets.picture: FRONT view of Evergreen Bramble: his same messy brown hair and face, his leaf crown now made of a few solid holly leaves with small round red berries; a dark-green poncho shaped in three layered pointed tiers like a little pine tree (smooth solid shapes, no needles), with a few small round red and gold ornaments on it; his same small satchel; brown shorts; dark-green socks; brown boots
